overview_description.description: ARSANN specializes in consulting services and offers a parking management app that allows operators to monitor cars entering and leaving their facilities. The company also links gig-workers with part-time job opportunities, enhancing workforce flexibility. Additionally, ARSANN collaborates with partners to build smart EV charging networks at parking facilities, contributing to sustainable transportation solutions.

product.name: Valet Service
product.description: A service allowing customers to have their cars parked by a professional attendant without the need for a parking ticket.

product.name: Self-Parking Service
product.description: A service enabling customers to park their own vehicles without assistance.

product.name: Payment Machines
product.description: Devices that facilitate the payment process for parking services, integrating advanced technology for ease of use.

product.name: Access Control
product.description: Systems that manage and control vehicle entry and exit in parking facilities using advanced technology.

product.name: Sensors & Parking Guidance System
product.description: Technology that assists drivers in finding available parking spaces through sensors and guidance systems.
